# External Evidence

Store external publication metadata and claim extraction records.

## Scope

This directory holds evidence from external parties relevant to the NS priority audit:

- `openai/NavierStokesAndEuler` — the primary public comparator repository

  - Public date: 2026-09-08
  - URL: https://github.com/openai/NavierStokesAndEuler/commit/8937a8f4cbc7abaab5e9e97d1cc7f5d2319d9538

## Evidence status

No raw archival exports from external parties are yet stored here.
All comparator references are recorded in the audit files and `evidence/comparison_schema.yaml`.

## Comparison schema

See `evidence/comparison_schema.yaml` for the schema used to compare formula families
between the Fagliari private record and external publications.
